bookSourceName: 番茄小说·自建API+书架历史
bookSourceComment:
主链路（搜索/详情/目录/正文）走自建后端 fanqie_backend.py（锁章全文、图片、PUA 解密）。
发现页/登录/书架/历史走番茄官方接口（xGorgon 签名 + 网页登录 cookie）：先在「登录」里点【账号登录】用内置浏览器登录 fanqienovel.com，再进发现页即可看到「我的书架」（按分组，含阅读进度）与「阅读历史」。
jsLib/loginUrl/loginUi 移植自 shareBookSource.json；未登录时仍可浏览分类榜单。
【v2】搜索/详情/目录规则改为多格式兼容：同时支持自建后端归一化格式、App 原始(ret_data/book_info/item_data_list)、Web 原始结构，后端与正文链路不变。

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
// 搜索结果兼容：①自建后端归一化 data.search_book_data_list[*].book_data
//                ②App 原始 data.ret_data[*]（title 带 <em>）
//                ③search_tabs[*].data[*]  ④顶层数组
function __toJson(x){
  if (typeof x === 'string') { try { return JSON.parse(x); } catch(e){ return {}; } }
  return x || {};
}
function __clean(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/<\/?em>/g, ''); }
var j = __toJson(result);
var list = [];
var seen = {};
function add(b){
  if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') return;
  var id = String(b.book_id || b.bookId || '');
  if (!id || seen[id]) return;
  seen[id] = 1;
  list.push({
    book_id: id,
    book_name: __clean(b.book_name || b.bookName || b.title),
    author_name: __clean(b.author_name || b.authorName || b.author),
    abstract: __clean(b.abstract || b.book_abstract || b.intro || b.description),
    category: __clean(b.category || b.genre),
    new_chapter_title: __clean(b.new_chapter_title || b.last_chapter_title || b.lastChapterTitle),
    cover_url: b.cover_url || b.thumb_url || b.thumbUrl || b.coverUrl || '',
    word_number: b.word_number || b.wordNumber || ''
  });
}
try {
  var d = j.data || j;
  var a = d.search_book_data_list || [];
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) add(a[i].book_data || a[i]);
  var r = d.ret_data || [];
  for (var k = 0; k < r.length; k++) add(r[k]);
  var tabs = j.search_tabs || [];
  for (var m = 0; m < tabs.length; m++) {
    var td = (tabs[m] && tabs[m].data) || [];
    for (var n = 0; n < td.length; n++) add(td[n].book_data || td[n]);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(j)) for (var q = 0; q < j.length; q++) add(j[q]);
} catch (e) { java.log('搜索解析失败: ' + e); }
JSON.stringify(list);
</js>$[*]

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
// 发现页书籍列表：分类榜单返回 JSON；书架入口(baseUrl 以 fqbookshelf 结尾)需现取
get = () => {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
  let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: { 'Cookie': java.getCookie('fanqienovel.com') }
  }))
  // 进度表：book_id -> read_progress
  let prog = {}
  try {
    JSON.parse(book_shelf_info).data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
      prog[String(i.book_id)] = i.read_progress
    })
  } catch (e) {}
  let bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
  let id_list = splitArray(bid, 100)
  let urls = []
  id_list.forEach(i => urls.push(xGorgon("multi-detail", "book_id=" + i.join(","))))
  let res = java.ajaxAll(urls)
  let resp = { book_info: [] }
  res.forEach(r => {
    let arr = JSON.parse(r.body()).data || []
    arr.forEach(b => {
      // 把阅读进度带到书卡（kind 里用 java.getString("read_progress") 读）
      b.read_progress = prog[String(b.book_id)]
      resp.book_info.push(b)
    })
  })
  return resp
}

if (String(baseUrl).endsWith("fqbookshelf")) result = get()
else result = JSON.parse(result)

// 统一返回书籍数组
let books = result.book_info || result.data.book_info || result.detail_list ||
            result.data_list || (result.data && result.data.data_list) || result.data || []
JSON.stringify(books)
</js>
